list.text: How about a quick battle first?
I'd say I'm a better swimmer than you. Yeah!
No inflatable tube for me.\nI'm hanging on to a sea Pokémon!
While I float like this, the waves carry me along.
Hey, you're young and fit!\nDon't ride your Pokémon! Swim!

lines: EndSpeech: Nossa! Minha pele está horrível.

list.text: Swimming exercises your entire body.\nIt's healthy.
The water's warm here. I'm loose and limber. Sure, I'll take you on!
Isn't it relaxing, just floating like this?
I'm on my way to the Whirl Islands.\nI'm going exploring with friends.

lines: EndSpeech: Oh! Você tem mais energia do que eu.

list.text: There's supposed to be a big Pokémon deep beneath the Whirl Islands.\nI wonder what it could be?
At night, STARYU gather near the water's surface.
The clusters of STARYU light up at the same time. It's so beaultiful, it's scary.
I'm a bit tired. If I win, lend me your Pokémon.

lines: EndSpeech: Qual é o segredo da sua força?

list.text: It's so far to Cianwood. But it's no easy return trip to Olivine either.\nWhat should I do?
Are you seeking the secrets of the Whirl Islands?

lines: EndSpeech: Qual é o segredo da sua força?

list.text: A secret about the Whirl Islands... It's pitch black inside!
